title: Not effective for real editing needs
text:
Tried to simply remove an odd haze effect from top half of my two subjects caused by the setting sun and the angle of our shot.  Their bottom half was great in original photo.  App had no features for this directly to clean up and enhance.  There was an AI feature that did clean up haze and looked great.  However it also completely removed one subjects arm at the elbow with no way of adjusting to get it back.  

Ai feature has a describe option that is not a true “describe”.  You have three options, change BG to beach, back highlight hair, and remove people.  No text describe option.  

App needs a lot of work with more user interface and not so much preset options.  

One option in an example is removing objects like a chain link fence.  No real option for this in the AI feature where it directs you to perform.  

App is only good for AI fun not real editing those great shots with fixable error that other apps can fix.

title: Zero customer service
text:
Whilst the app has a few useful features (which many phones have as a standard now anyway) I’ll never recommend this app because when I needed help, I was never helped. They ignored every e-mail I ever sent and to this day, still haven’t bothered responding. 

Anyone thinking of using them, you’ll be on your own and they won’t treat you well at all. Between login failures and zero customer service, 1 star is being generous.

They should be ashamed of their level of customer care.

The developers have since responded to this review saying if I have any issues, to reach out to them via e-mail…………WHAT DO YOU THINK I’VE DOING FOR MONTHS NOW! 

Their developer responses on here just seem like they’re there to sound like they care, when they’ve shown time and time again that they do NOT! 

At this point, if I could give zero stars, I would!
